I went to primary school so I can read what is written on a seed packet, but this plot is only 0.13 hectares and it is not mine, so I will not spend my little cash on fertilizer or improved seed here. I will sow the local bean and groundnut seed I kept from last season, and my family will work this small piece with hoes for about 14 days from planting through harvest. I will not buy chemicals or pay workers for a rented plot this small, and in Dowa we depend on the rains, so I will not irrigate.
